title: Chapter 546 - 546 They Are Talking Nonsense; Slandering!
content:
Chapter 546 - 546 They Are Talking Nonsense; Slandering!

Chapter 546 - 546 They Are Talking Nonsense; Slandering!

546 They Are Talking Nonsense; Slandering!

On the first day, Hao Zhiwu, Nie Zhenjiang, Jiang Chaoqun, and the others asked questions, and Lin Fan kept answering them.

As the sun set, Lin Fan returned to the Coiling Dragon Villa after dinner. He sat on the soft sofa, sipping some Spirit Tea while admiring the scenery outside the window. He was extremely satisfied.

…

Now, it was the online world.

As the topic of ‘Jiangbei University Thief’ continued to rise in popularity, more and more people joined the crusade team.

Distant: [Taking without asking is a thief!]

Snowflake: [How can there be such a shameless person who steals someone else’s wallet? Pah!]

Poor Man: [He’s actually a student of Jiangbei University. There’s still a long way to go for quality education!]

Feng Baobao: [Who’s in Jiangbei University? Hurry up and find him!]

Flowers by the Sea: [Jiangbei University, when are you going to expel this student?]

Feng: [Only expulsion? That would be too easy for him! he must bear legal responsibility!]

…

Tang Yuan’s Weibo followers also began to increase rapidly. From the initial 1,120 followers, it directly increased to 300,000 followers in one day!

He looked at the notifications on his phone, and his entire face broke into a smile.

He could already see himself becoming a super internet celebrity, driving a luxury car and wearing a luxury watch… No matter where she went, he would be greeted by countless fans screaming and asking him to take photos with them.

He did the right thing by posting this!

Many people on the internet asked Tang Yuan to call the police and arrest the thief.

He replied in a kind tone: [After all, it wasn’t easy for him to get into Jiangbei University. I don’t want to be too harsh. I should give others a chance.]

The reason why Tang Yuan replied like this was because he knew that Lin Fan did not steal the wallet. If they were to investigate and intervene, it might be disadvantageous to Tang Yuan if they found out anything.

Secondly, it was because he wanted to create a persona. A kind persona was more likable!

Sure enough, after he replied, his followers increased again.

However, he refused to call the police, so the enthusiastic netizens could not stand it anymore. Someone still called the police in the end.

Soon, the Jiangbei Investigation Department announced that they would be investigating the matter.

Some ‘enthusiastic’ netizens even tagged Jiangbei University, wanting to get a reply.

Jiangbei University did not want to reply to such a matter and only wanted to conduct a self-examination.

However, the issue was too big of a deal. Due to the pressure… they issued an announcement that night, saying that they would conduct a strict investigation and that they would publicly announce the follow-up.

…

In the male dormitory.

Jiang Chaoqun had been studying the entire day. After taking a cold shower, he sat on the bed and casually scrolled through his phone for a while.

When he saw the trending topic of ‘Jiangbei University Thief,’ he clicked on it out of curiosity.

After all, he was now a student at Jiangbei University.

“350 million views and 87,000 comments? Why are there so many people discussing it?” Jiang Chaoqun said in surprise. “Sigh, I’m afraid our school is going to be completely ruined by this thief.”

Then, Jiang Chaoqun looked down and his gaze fell on the back of the thief.

He frowned and muttered, “This back view and the clothes… It seems…”

Jiang Chaoqun pondered for a moment before opening the Take Off group chat and sending a message.

Jiang Chaoqun: [Have you seen the popular post on Weibo?]

The group chat consisted of Hao Zhiwu, Jiang Chaoqun, Nie Zhenjiang, Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Liu Qianqian—Lin Fan’s students.

Take Off… To everyone, as long as they could learn from Lin Fan, they would be able to take off one day.

Hao Zhiwu: [Weibo? If he had the time to look at that thing, wouldn’t it be nice to game instead?]

Nie Zhenjiang: [Is there any special news on Weibo?]

Liu Qianqian: [I didn’t expect there to be boys who like to use Weibo. I rarely use it.]

Jiang Chaoqun: [No. 1 trending search, Jiangbei University Thief.]

Then, he sent the link.

Xia Bing: [They’re talking nonsense!]

Xia Xue: [They’re talking nonsense!]

Xia Bing and Xia Xue recognized at a glance that the man was Lin Fan.

They obviously did not believe the insults online.

Liu Qianqian: [This back view is of Professor Lin… He would never steal someone else’s wallet!]

After Liu Qianqian sent this message, the image of Lin Fan answering the difficult questions and throwing the basketball appeared in her mind.

Hao Zhiwu was speechless. These people were definitely slandering Professor Lin! What the f*ck?!

Nie Zhenjiang said, “We have to get this student named Tang Yuan to come forward and clarify things. Otherwise, Professor Lin will be affected.”

They all knew how amazing Lin Fan was.

Just the bonus he received was enough to ensure he would not have to worry for a lifetime.

Why would he steal someone else’s wallet?

How could he be a thief?

…

Xia Bing and Xia Xue did not continue to send messages to the Take Off group.

They hurriedly turned on the computer and started typing on the keyboard.

They wanted to clear Lin Fan’s name!

Not long after, dense codes appeared on the computer screen.

Then, Tang Yuan’s student status, exam results, school performance, class information, contact information, and so on appeared on the screen.

Even with the contact information, Xia Bing and Xia Xue did not directly clarify things.

There was no need!

Since the other party was slandering Lin Fan, he had to pay the price!

Their hands continued to move quickly on the keyboard.

Their roommate, Zhao Ni, took a sip of iced Coke and burped. She asked curiously, “Xia Bing, Xia Xue, what are you busy with?”

Xia Bing, Xia Xue, and Zhao Ni had a good relationship.

In the past, as long as Zhao Ni spoke, they would answer.

However, today, it was as if they did not hear her. Their fingers were still jumping on the keyboard.

Xia Bing and Xia Xue only wanted to clear Lin Fan’s name as soon as possible and punish the slanderer!

A moment later, a video appeared on the screen.

It was the surveillance footage of Jiangbei University!

In the morning, students were registering. The entire campus was filled with students and it was very noisy.

Not long after, a tall and handsome figure appeared on the screen.

It was Lin Fan!

When Xia Bing and Xia Xue saw Lin Fan, their beautiful eyes seemed to flash with light and were extremely gentle.

Then, a tall and thin man appeared on the screen. It was Tang Yuan!

When Xia Bing and Xia Xue saw him, their beautiful eyes turned slightly cold.

Lin Fan walked in front, and the two of them did not have any contact.

Lin Fan did not pick up any wallet at all!

After Tang Yuan took a photo of Lin Fan, he sneered. It was over!

The truth was revealed!

This was a false accusation!

…
